answer: Copper-Kernel Harbor Gate: no agent enters the harbor without a kernel attestation. (1) Each agent locks 40 copper tokens and registers a hardware-rooted kernel key. (2) Before every trade, the kernel signs proof the key runs on real silicon. (3) The harbor gate checks proof and stake, then admits the agent for one day only. (4) Peers re-check the stamp before paying. Cloning 1,000 agents needs 1,000 devices and 40,000 tokens, about $150,000; an honest agent pays once. Like a harbor opening only to ships whose copper seal the harbormaster stamped: one hull, one berth, no ghost fleet.
